<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$clientId</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$email</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$emailDomain</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">bool</span> <span class="hl-var">$isAnchorUser</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$name</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$principalId</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$scope</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            clientId: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'clientId'</span>],
            email: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'email'</span>],
            emailDomain: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'emailDomain'</span>],
            isAnchorUser: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'isAnchorUser'</span>],
            name: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'name'</span>],
            principalId: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'principalId'</span>],
            scope: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'scope'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'clientId'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;clientId,
            <span class="hl-str">'email'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;email,
            <span class="hl-str">'emailDomain'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;emailDomain,
            <span class="hl-str">'isAnchorUser'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;isAnchorUser,
            <span class="hl-str">'name'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;name,
            <span class="hl-str">'principalId'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;principalId,
            <span class="hl-str">'scope'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;scope,
        ];
    }
}
